## Project

This website was created for BU AD688 Assignment 01. It demonstrates a reproducible cloud-based data science environment using AWS EC2, Python, PySpark, Git, GitHub, and Quarto.

## Environment

- Platform: AWS EC2
- Operating system: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
- Python environment: Virtual environment
- Big data framework: PySpark 4.0
- Version control: Git and GitHub
- Publishing platform: GitHub Pages
